Now I understand the structure. Let me write the implementation files.

Both verifies pass (`pnpm verify` exits 0; the task verify reports 39/39). Result written.

Summary of the work:

- **`src/core/vcs/tree-record.ts`** (new): `treeRecordPath` resolves `<git-common-dir>/osq-trees.jsonl` when `vcs.enabled` is true (no git otherwise), plus `resolveTreeRecordPath` (binary-injectable resolver) and `appendTreeRecord` (writes the `{"at","op","root"}` line, swallowing failures).
- **`src/core/vcs/git-vcs-recording.ts`** (new): `RecordingGitVcs extends GitVcs`, overriding `worktreeAdd`, `worktreeRemove`, `worktreePrune`, `commit`, and `fastForward` to record one line after success (`fast-forward` only on `done`), resolving the record path once lazily.
- **`src/core/vcs/select.ts`**: returns `RecordingGitVcs` wherever it returned `GitVcs`.
- **`tests/vcs-tree-record.test.ts`** (new): proves all five "Tree record" scenarios via `scenario('version-control', ...)`, including every "Record path" table row, using the temp-repo and hook patterns from the named entry tests.

No port member was added, so `tests/vcs-write.test.ts`'s `PORT_MEMBERS` stayed unchanged.
